messages:
marta: quick check — thinking of adding 'event_type' to streaming delta chunks so func_call chunks have "event_type":"func_call". This helps clients drop partial text. Will that break any SDKs?

sam: @marta probably yes for some clients. We should gate behind an opt-in header. Suggest X-Redwood-Stream-Mode: v2 (default v1). :thinking_face:

liam: +1 on opt-in. Also need to document how this affects resume/reassembly. If clients assume every delta is text they might concatenate wrongly.

ana: I'll add a lint rule in api-contracts to flag consumers that parse deltas as raw strings. I'll PR a schema example.

marta: thx. Proposed polyfill patch (staged):
```
// server side: stream payload example
{ "type": "delta", "event_type": "func_call", "payload": { "name": "get_weather", "args": "{\"city\":\"SF\"}" }}
```

sam: can we also emit a sequence_id in each delta for reassembly? That would help ordering when multiplexing.

liam: sequence_id ok, but keep it numeric and optional. Backcompat: if header missing, server must emit same shape as today (no event_type/seq).

deploy-bot: canary: v2-streaming opted into staging cluster (redwood-staging-03) — monitor perf/clients for 30m.

ana: opened PR: https://github.com/redwood/api-contracts/pull/789 — includes examples, header matrix, and SDK notes. Please review.

marta: thanks. @sam @liam can you review SDK implications? aim to ship opt-in within 2 weeks. :rocket:
